safety_pledge.title: EssenShare Food Safety Pledge (v1.0)
safety_pledge.subtitle: Our mutual-aid pact ensuring all redistributed food is safe, dignified, and hygienic.
safety_pledge.rule1_desc: Only donate food you would feel confident eating yourself or serving to loved ones. Food must be strictly within its use-by limit and free from spoilage or contamination.
safety_pledge.rule2_desc: Chilled perishable items must be maintained below 5°C (41°F) and frozen items below -18°C (0°F) right until handover. Never allow perishable foods to sit in the temperature danger zone.
safety_pledge.rule3_desc: Clearly state all major allergens (gluten, peanuts, tree nuts, dairy, eggs, soy, fish, sesame, etc.). If ingredients are uncertain, declare 'May contain unknown allergens'.
safety_pledge.rule4_desc: Use clean, food-grade containers or original manufacturer sealed packaging. Prepared meals must be covered and labeled with the date/time prepared.
safety_pledge.rule5_desc: All surplus is shared freely without fee, commercial warranty, or discrimination. Food handovers are conducted with mutual respect, dignity, and care.
safety_pledge.banner_subtitle: Before posting or verifying food handovers, please accept the EssenShare Food Safety Policy to protect recipient health.
safety_pledge.accept_checkbox: I have read and agree to uphold the EssenShare Food Safety Pledge
